name: Views HTMX
description: Reactive Views exposed filters and pagination via HTMX, using Drupal core.
project_description:
Reactive Views with HTMX — no JavaScript required.

 Views HTMX replaces Drupal's legacy Ajax framework for exposed filters, pagination, and table sorting with HTMX , available natively in Drupal core since 11.2.

 Exposed filters auto-submit as you type — no "Apply" button needed.

Filter changes, page navigation, and column sorting update only the results region — no full page reload, no custom JavaScript. Cache metadata, Drupal behaviors, and asset loading are handled automatically by the core HTMX integration.

 Requirements: Drupal 11.2+
